description: Add capability, category, save-path, and queue-state discovery needed for path and import diagnosis.
acceptance: Authentication and version discovery are explicit.
Queue output is normalized and redacted.
Category and path data integrate with doctor rules without exposing download names.
The adapter reuses transport-01 for endpoint policy, credentials, retries, typed failures, and redaction rather than implementing a private HTTP stack.
Fast synthetic fixture tests and a focused real-container qbittorrent lane both pass.
Read-only operation performs no domain mutation; any required authentication session is explicitly classified and side-effect-free.
